item.description: More than two hundred livestock farms in Vermont and New Hampshire will get help with conservation planning. A six point four million dollar grant supports this effort. The program promotes sustainable farming practices.

Vermont has expanded homeless shelter capacity to seven hundred twenty-one households this fall, up from five hundred eighty-three last year. The state’s homeless population numbers nearly three thousand three hundred, though that is likely an undercount. New shelters have opened in Brattleboro, Middlebury, and White River Junction to help during the cold months.

Silloway Maple of Cornwall Vermont was honored at the Vermont Maple Sugar Makers' annual awards. A brother and sister team from Randolph also received recognition. The event celebrates excellence in maple syrup production.

Multiple Hartford Town departments are temporarily relocating due to HVAC system problems. The move aims to address the issues while keeping services running. Officials have not detailed which departments are affected or how long the relocations will last.
